newsitem.title: UK: Pearson defies firm market, registers fall.
newsitem.headline: Pearson defies firm market, registers fall.

text.p: Shares in Pearson Plc were one of the few stocks to be marked noticeably lower on Wednesday as the broader stock market pushed ahead, dealers said.
Pearson shares were off 9.5 pence, or 1.30 percent, at 719p by 1130 GMT on low volume of 310,000, while the FTSE-100 index was up 46.4 points, or 1.07 percent, at 4,392.5.
Dealers and analysts said there was no particular story behind the move.
"It's all happened in very thin volume so it's not as if there's a big seller in there," said one trader at a British bank.
Thames Water, down 7p at 670p, was the only other FTSE-100 stock off more than one percent on the day.
There were 77 FTSE gainers to 16 losers.
